manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift two the white shoe with tongue logo, tips pointing left, into the rectangular Nike box for shoes.

Task description: Place the two white shoes with logos on their tongues into the open orange rectangular Nike shoebox in front, with both toes pointing toward the left side of the image.

Success criteria: The shoe on the left in the current image is near the center-front of the box (lower in the image), and the right shoe near the center-back (upper in the image). Both lie flat near the box bottom, soles down and toes left. Both grippers are open and have released the shoes.

## Execution tips

- Span the shoe width and grip continuous middle side surfaces, opening slightly wider than local width. Confirm pads surround the shoe before closing rather than merely pressing the tongue, laces or upper.
- When turning the shoe toe, do so with the whole shoe above the box rim and away from the other shoe, avoiding brushing the box wall with the toe or heel.
- While lowering into the box, adjust based on clearance between the toe, heel, fingers, and box rim to leave room to open the gripper. Avoid trapping the fingers between the shoe and box wall or the other shoe.
- Release only after the shoe sole is supported by the box bottom. When withdrawing the fingers, avoid the shoe opening and laces, reducing the risk of lifting or changing the shoe's orientation.
